optimizedDescription.value: Lifecycle-managed `CodeGraphProvider` composes store, adapters, indexing, traversal, recovery, search, and host APIs.

optimizedContext.value:
# Composition

## Rules

- `CodeGraphProvider`: lifecycle-managed top-level facade. `index(options: IndexOptions): Promise<IndexResult>`; `options.force` clears logical contents and reprocesses selected inputs, never physical recreation. `recreate(): Promise<void>` physically recovers unusable storage only while closed; open call throws typed closed-provider precondition error; success leaves closed. `clear()` clears logical graph in opened reusable store without generation change. `open()` parameterless; never implicitly recreates; corruption/incompatible schema yields typed recoverable storage-open error. `close()` idempotent, settles/rejects outstanding work before shutdown.
- Query/store delegates: `getSymbol`, `findSymbols`, `getFile`, `getDocument`, config-relative file/document lookup, spec/coverage lookup, statistics, exact batches, full-text search. `getSpec` returns `undefined` when absent. Traversal, impact, selector normalization preserved. Each composite operation performs exactly one availability/staleness validation before bounded fan-out. Worker protocol and lock helpers internal.
- Primary factory: `createCodeGraphProvider(config: SpecdConfig, options?: CodeGraphCompositionOptions): CodeGraphProvider`. Derives storage root from `config.configPath`; selects `options.graphStoreId` or `sqlite`; merges exactly built-in `sqlite` factory plus additive `options.graphStoreFactories`; deterministically rejects external `sqlite` collision; unknown id throws registry unknown-backend error. Creates exactly one selected `GraphStore`, built-in TypeScript/Python/Go/PHP adapters plus additive `options.adapters`, `IndexCodeGraph`, wired provider. Provider retains no config.
- Legacy factory: `createCodeGraphProvider(options: CodeGraphOptions): CodeGraphProvider`; requires `storagePath`; same `graphStoreId`, `graphStoreFactories`, `adapters` behavior. Overload detection uses project-root-bearing `SpecdConfig` shape. `Readonly<Record<string, GraphStoreFactory>>` permits at most one external factory/id.
- `createSqliteGraphStoreFactory()` accepts `SqliteGraphStoreFactoryOptions`, including optional serializable `SqliteRuntimeDescriptor`. Factory/provider creation synchronous; native loading, worker startup, schema preparation, binding resolution, generation checks occur during `open()`.
- `CodeGraphProvider` public type-only interface. Concrete implementation/constructor, `GraphStore`, worker protocol, `IndexCodeGraph` inputs internal. Sole construction path: `createCodeGraphProvider(...)`.
- Public `.` exports curated composition types/factories; `runIsolatedGraphIndex` and host-facing input/progress/result/typed worker failure contracts; host use cases `GetGraphHealth`, `IndexProjectGraph`, `GetSpecCoverage`, `GetChangeSpecCoverage` plus inputs/results/factories; VCS/config, index/discovery, traversal/impact, hotspot, search, fingerprint, `LanguageAdapter`, model/reference/coverage/unified-search vocabulary; `CODE_GRAPH_VERSION`; `SpecdCodeGraphError` subclasses including `StoreNotOpenError`, `InvalidSymbolKindError`, `InvalidRelationTypeError`, `DuplicateSymbolIdError`, `SpecNotFoundError`, `GraphProviderStaleError`, `StoreOverloadError`, `StoreWorkerError`, `BulkSessionStateError`, `InvalidGraphStoreConfigurationError`, `GraphSchemaIncompatibleError`, `GraphStorageRecoveryRequiredError`, `GraphStoreRecreateRequiresClosedError`, graph-busy and isolated-worker failures.
- Public `.` maps curated `src/public.ts`; `./internal` maps full `src/index.ts`, including `InMemoryIndexSession`, concrete SQLite adapter, indexer/store internals, raw locks/process launchers. Built ESM isolated-worker child ships under `dist/`, resolved internally, never host-selectable export. No unrestricted public star exports, raw IPC/child bootstrap, concrete stores, test worker helpers, direct locks, backend recreation mechanics. Removed Ladybug symbols stay removed.
- Lifecycle explicit: caller opens before queries/traversal/index unless helper manages lifecycle; no auto-open/close. Long-lived hosts create synchronously, open once, reuse without synchronous SQLite event-loop blocking, close on shutdown/replacement. Public callers use SDK forced-reindex recovery path, not ordinary recreation.
- Runtime dependency `@specd/core` supplies `SpecdConfig`, `SpecdWorkspaceConfig`, metadata/spec services. Factory derives composition inputs only; caller passes workspace targets/spec sources through each `IndexOptions`.
- Host use cases receive already-open provider. `GetGraphHealth`: statistics/staleness/fingerprint. `IndexProjectGraph`: project indexing with optional force recovery. Coverage use cases: single-spec/change aggregation. Search/hotspots/impact/traversal remain facade methods.
- Symbol-reference facade exposes single/batch resolution, canonical-symbol/public-binding impact, exact public-binding lookup by surface + exported name + symbol space + canonical target. Exact lookup returns binding/declarations without ranked/paginated search. Outcomes: unique, ambiguous, missing. Unqualified selectors try case-exact then case-insensitive exact only; never prefix/text widening; ambiguity bounded. Host validation failures use typed graph error code `INVALID_GRAPH_SELECTOR`; candidate enrichment uses exactly one exact batch lookup. Resolver implementations/backend details internal.
- Unified search accepts query, requested `symbols | files | specs | documents`, shared filters, per-category limit, snippets. Exact file filters normalize canonical workspace-relative, config/project-relative, or absolute path to one graph file; wildcards remain patterns. Application use case owns shared plan, semantic/backend lanes, exact occurrences, symbol-range suppression, grouping/ranking, occurrence caps, and post-suppression category limits. Exact single-file search returns every retained occurrence. Delivery adapters never reproduce expansion, independent category merge, deduplication, or final limiting. Lower-level search may remain; unified operation authoritative.

## Constraints

- `createCodeGraphProvider` only construction path; exactly one active `GraphStore`.
- Backend selection registry-driven, composition-internal, never `specd.yaml`; default/built-in `sqlite`.
- Facade owns lifecycle, availability, indexing locks, destructive recovery; domain logic delegated.
- Explicit lifecycle; no auto-open/auto-close.
- Internal/store adapters only from `./internal`; `LanguageAdapter` public from `.`.
- Runtime dependency: `@specd/core`.
